The '''battle of Ukio''' was a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Let's get to business here Liege. You will allow my troops full access to your shield generator assembly so we can see how you operate your defenses.''"<br />"''Of course. We are proud of our defenses here.''"<br />"''While I will acquaint myself with some of the local workers.|Padawan Xebec talking with Liege upon his arrival on Ukio.|<ref name="Date" />}}
[[File:BattleOfUkio-AoI.png|thumb|left|200px|Reus and Fisto engaged in battle with Separatist forces over Ukio]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], an intergalactic conflict between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] sent [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], [[Keelyvine Reus]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Tyzen Xebec]] to inspect the energy shield on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] along with several [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. The Republic feared the [[Ukian/Legends|Ukians]] were unprepared to hold off an attack from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. The planet was also the main source of supplies, like food, for other planets in the [[Abrion sector/Legends|sector]] and planets along the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]]. Because of this, Ukio could not fall under Separatist control.

The Jedi and several [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] inspected the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]], when the Separatists "launched" an attack on Ukio. Reus suggested a quick recon in their [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Jedi interceptors]]. Fisto and Reus flew near the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Trade Federation battleship]] and saw that the ship launched several modified [[Seismic tank/Legends|seismic tanks]] which dropped a cloud of soil from the planet [[Moorja/Legends|Moorja]], onto the planetary shield.
